mgmt_bio.text: Lukas Paravicini became chief executive of Imperial Brands on 1 October 2025, having served as chief financial officer since May 2021. As finance chief he was credited with driving the consistent growth of the past four years and led the company's technology and data transformation programme, making his promotion a continuity appointment: he co-authored the 2030 strategy he is now executing. The market initially reacted badly to the announcement of Bomhard's departure in May 2025, with the shares falling 7.5% that day, reflecting Bomhard's strong five-year turnaround record.
